# Tables

Each table of addresses, jumps and words, entry by entry. An RTS table holds each target minus 1; the target column gives the target. Index: [the reference](index.md).

<a id="entry_jump_table"></a>
## [`entry_jump_table`](../../src/init/entry.asm#L6) `$0900-$091A`

*jumps*

JMP table at the start of the program. $0900 cold_start (the entry), $0903 wait_for_hit ($1c37), $0906 sample_pad, $0909 an RTS, $090c wait_jiffies, $090f hit_test, $0912 $1523, $0915 $1895, $0918 $275c. The program uses only $0900 and $0906 (from read_cursor at $19d8). The Mayday! release starts at $092f and does not execute $0900.

<a id="run_script"></a>
## [`run_script`](../../src/script/interpreter.asm#L6) `$4202-$420A`

*jumps*

Script interpreter: A/Y is the address of a script. Each opcode byte selects a routine in script_ops. Opcode $ff ends the script, or returns from a script call. An opcode with bit 7 set takes its operands from the argument stack in place of the script.

|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | [`$4202`](../../src/script/interpreter.asm#L7) | `$420B` | [`run_script_start` `$420B`](../../src/script/interpreter.asm#L16) |

| 2 | [`$4208`](../../src/script/interpreter.asm#L14) | `$44FC` | [`read_cell_colour` `$44FC`](../../src/graphics/read_pixel.asm#L17) |
